function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a rigorous, source-grounded investigation of the public-fraud trail involving Wirecard AG and Jan Marsalek, using information available up to and including Thu Oct 1, 2026. Reconstruct a chronological and evidentiary account linking: (1) Wirecard’s public company statements, financial reporting, and denials; (2) auditor uncertainty, emphasis, qualifications, or failures and the timing of audit opinions; (3) discovery, verification status, and location or non-location of the missing 1.9 billion euros in trustee accounts; (4) regulatory, supervisory, governmental, law-enforcement, and parliamentary failures or alleged failures; and (5) Jan Marsalek’s disappearance, alleged movements, investigations, and current status. Distinguish carefully between verified facts, allegations, interpretations, official findings, assessments, and unresolved uncertainty. Identify contradictions between sources and evidentiary gaps. Do not invent facts, entities, identifiers, relationship names, or citations. Return a structured research dossier with a dated timeline, entity and relationship evidence, source IDs for every material assertion, source titles or issuing bodies, and explicit labels for fact/allegation/assessment/uncertainty. Prioritize primary or official sources (Wirecard disclosures, auditor reports, court and parliamentary materials, regulators, prosecutors, insolvency administrator, and reputable reporting where primary evidence is unavailable)."}
function.name: ConductResearch
